message.content:
1) **Close button:** Yes — a visible X in the top-right of the modal, styled as a proper circular button (white circle with thin gold/tan border and an ✕ glyph). It looks clickable.

2) **Overlap:** No — it sits cleanly in its own space; no text is underneath or clipped by it.

3) **Layout:** Well-structured: a red "▼ Pressures gold" label at top, bold title "Real yields (inflation-adjusted)", then a two-to-three-line description about inflation-beating bonds as gold's rival. Nothing is clipped; spacing between elements is consistent.

4) **Overall:** Yes — clean, compact, readable, with a proper close affordance and no visual defects. Functional.
